headline: Insurance renewals, elevator maintenance contract, MRVP rent standards, admin plan rental increase changes, and reasonable accommodation policy updates.
summary: The meeting covers insurance renewals for commercial property and liability, an elevator maintenance contract, and MRVP Project-Based Voucher maximum contract rents and mobile payment standards. It also includes proposed changes to rental increase rules, the federal public housing reasonable accommodation policy, an amendment to LHA Contract for Financial Assistance 5010, and an executive session on real estate.
